requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Consolidate the naming of HP OJP 9010 series printers on 123.hp.com and support.hp.com to a single reference name to reduce user confusion and errors.
requirements.Additional_Comments: Is there a reason to have 3 names for the same reference? HP OJP 9010 All-in-one Printer series, HP OJP 9010e All-in-One Printer series, HP OJP 9010 All-in-One Printer. Having too many names isn't efficient and can induce user errors.
requirements.Threshold: Two names/reference are proposed; currently 4 references for Office Jet Pro 9010.
requirements.Goal: Only one name/reference is proposed to customer.
requirements.Remarks: Quality team is following-up with Tais Bellini. 20210702 (Chris/Jess) Not possible to change in 123.hp.com as it references Product Master List shared with PC group. Only possible at support.hp.com. Proposed to Drop.

requirements.Requirement: Printer able to run all new/current EM / market segment media
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Printer must be able to operate with all new and current EM (evaluation media) and market segment media, meeting intervention specifications for all climatic conditions relevant to the Manhattan platform.
requirements.Additional_Comments: Printer to meet intervention spec for the different media and climatic conditions for Manhattan platform.
requirements.Goal: Pass intervention rate and NO PQ issue
requirements.Remarks: 20220920(Sau Pin): LP2 Life test are meeting Intervention rate(Qual) 20220316 (Sau Pin): Baseline assumed same as Manhattan. Status as 'Yellow' as intervention performance needs review. Accept threshold. EM media as Eval media.

requirements.Requirement: Product can be placed and work on uneven surface ( sofa , table cloth , carpet …)
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must function without input tray sensor flag breakage or operational issues when placed and used on uneven surfaces such as sofas, tablecloths, or carpets.
requirements.Additional_Comments: As the complain on Vasari, input tray sensor flag broken when printer is placed on uneven surface, this issue should be fixed in new product
requirements.Remarks: 20220315(Sau Pin): Marconi Base LP1 test with no issue reported. Marconi Hi and PDL SKUs testing on-going. HDRV response: Sanity check with Manhattan Base & Hi, Malbec Hi, Agave. Only Malbec Hi had tray flag broken. Need TME input on field data for 3M. Aiqiang: Manhattan field data shows tray 'fang' broken. ME will look at solutions to strengthen the fang.

requirements.Requirement: Tilt left and right each while printing
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Assess whether the printer experiences any functional failure when tilted 20 degrees to the left or right during printing.
requirements.Additional_Comments: To assess whether there is any functional failure if customer tilt the printer during printing.(Sayan tilt left and right each at 20 degree while printing )
requirements.Remarks: Tilt 20 degree is for CISS product as acknowledged by Michelle. Shin to check if to evaluate on Manhattan Plus with XXL ink cartridges. Close for Marconi.

requirements.Requirement: Put printer on trolley and print
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must be able to print without print quality issues when placed on a trolley.
requirements.Additional_Comments: To check if there is PQ issue when printer print on trolley.
requirements.Remarks: (Sau Pin): Marconi Base LP1 test with no issue reported. Marconi Hi and PDL SKUs testing on-going. HDRV response: Sanity check with Manhattan Base & Hi, Malbec Hi, Agave. No issue found. Agree to evaluate. To be consistent with standard UBT requirement.20220315
